units.source_text: “《卟—弗日报》的记者们无疑是支持工人的。

en.t: The reporters of the Pu-Fu Daily are undoubtedly supporting the workers.

units.source_text: 可是操纵记者们的，就只有哙哙了。

en.t: But the only one manipulating the reporters is Kwack.

units.source_text: 而哙哙又需要我嘎尔当后台老板来支援他。”

en.t: And Kwack in turn needs me, Gael, to act as his behind-the-scenes backer and support him.
